The head of product champions the pilot; the CFO wants engineers reallocated to utility-scale; the CEO is publicly neutral. The team is aware of the pilot's 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins.

The quarterly review meeting is scheduled to occur during the week starting 2026-10-05. The executive team will decide whether to formally shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot. If a decision is made, it will be communicated to the pilot team the same week.
